correctness.rationale: The formula is reconstructed algebraically from an exact unitary m-DFT polyphase decomposition into m identical 3x3 Fourier Vandermonde blocks. Explicit gauge diagonalization gives one odd and two symmetric eigenlevels. a>0, a-b>0 and a+b=2a cos(theta) rigorously establish the unique epsilon=1/4 band crossing and strict lower-band ordering. The expansions lambda_min=theta^4/27+O(theta^6), lambda_odd=4theta^2/3+O(theta^4), lambda_max=3+O(theta^2) yield sigma_min coefficient 4pi^2/(27sqrt3) and condition number coefficient 81/(4pi^2). Rank at epsilon=1 is exactly m. Complete-matrix standard-library checker passed 88 cases comparing moments one through three, with separate threshold and collision checks; those diagnostics are not a universal proof.

value.rationale: Fourier interpolation on recurrent nonuniform grids is a motivated sampling-stability setting. The result is a complete all-N singular spectrum for a natural symmetric three-channel family, with one sharp quarter-grid upper-mode degeneracy and an explicit triple-collision second-order singularity (distinct from known pair-collision first-order behavior). The exact constant controls coefficient and noise amplification and is not merely a generic rank or sign check. No arbitrary parameter slice or unmotivated finite census is required.
